name: shield-lock
useCase: Identify a protected access setting that requires authentication.
misuse: Do not use the shield as proof of security or permission; label the actual access state.

16.reason: A shorter lock body leaves its lower corners clear of the shield curve while preserving an open shackle and a visible body opening.

24.reason: The wider lock retains a larger body opening, with its lower edge lifted clear of the shield curve.
